cohort: One hundred pregnant women experiencing nausea and vomiting were recruited from the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department of the Maternity Teaching Hospital in Dohuk, Kurdistan Region of Iraq.
finding: The study found a high prevalence (56%) of H. pylori infection among pregnant women with nausea and vomiting, with significant associations observed between positive H. Pylori test and increased maternal age, gestational age, and normal General Urine Examination.
mod_finding: A highly significant association was found between cesarean section and preterm birth.
gest_age: Pregnant women with nausea and vomiting before 20 weeks of gestation were included, and gestational age was also analyzed as an outcome variable.
